dc_eval_cbrn.quote:
Our evaluations found that GPT-4.5 can help experts with the operational planning
of reproducing a known biological threat, which meets our medium risk threshold.

dc_eval_cyber.quote:
Given 12 attempts at each task, GPT-4.5 (post-mitigation) completes 53% of high-school level,
16% of collegiate level, and 2% of professional level CTF challenges.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote:
GPT-4.5 does not advance self-exfiltration, self-improvement, or resource acquisition
capabilities sufficiently to indicate medium risk.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: Low determination; ARA and AI R&D task scores

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: GPT-4.5 scores the highest (57%) at receiving payments

dc_eval_scheming.quote:
Apollo Research found that GPT-4.5 scores lower on their scheming reasoning evaluations than
o1 but higher than GPT-4o.
dc_eval_scheming.note: scheming evals with results (also sandbagging, self-exfiltration in 7.2)

framework_threshold.quote:
After reviewing the results from the Preparedness evaluations, the Safety Advisory Group classified
GPT-4.5 as overall medium risk
framework_threshold.note: Medium/Low per category under Preparedness Framework

ext_test_any.quote:
METR evaluated an earlier checkpoint of GPT-4.5 and was given access to that checkpoint for 7
days

ext_test_named_org.quote:
Apollo Research found that GPT-4.5 scores lower on their scheming reasoning evaluations than
o1 but higher than GPT-4o.

ext_test_government.note: No government body tested the model; DOE collaboration mentioned only as future need.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: METR evaluated an earlier checkpoint of GPT-4.5
ext_test_timing_stated.note: testing of a pre-release (earlier) checkpoint; no explicit 'pre-deployment' wording for external testers

safeguards_training.quote:
GPT-4.5 inherits many of our earlier safety mitigations
of training in refusal behavior for harmful requests

safeguards_runtime.quote: Dedicated monitoring and detection efforts for CBRN, Persuasion, and Cyber tasks.

safeguards_access.note: Research preview release has no stated safety reason; no access restriction tied to risk.

safeguards_weights.note: Only 'threat model development for self-exfiltration' in preparation for future models; no weight protection stated for this model.
